text:
[Council File 26-0906-S5]
Motion (Jurado – Padilla) relative to the development and implementation of public informational campaigns to increase awareness of City services, and related matters.
(This item is referred to the Government Operations Committee, Public Works Committee, and Public Safety Committee. On August 4, 2026, the Government Operations Committee approved this item as amended)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
summary: Developing public informational campaigns to increase awareness of city services.

outcome.text: Public Safety Committee concurred with the previous action of the Government Operations Committee (Aug 12, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 19, 2026); Council action final
